initial_application: No commit explicitly naming FHIR-12908 was found. Historical IG Publisher commits cdef2faffdfd4e4eab7c369a1a0935a19c1854f6 and dc0eeec9d0bc0cdecff7ab09b1a75c5be2b395bf changed dependent IG package loading and version-aware validator.pack/spec-map generation, including DSTU2 conversion paths, matching the defect class described by the issue.
additional_context: The old in-repository IG Publisher under tools/java/org.hl7.fhir.igtools was removed by 56ceb0df08dd72381a4f98f1ea4ac5ea6d139a8b because it had gone to Maven. The current checkout has no local Publisher.java files, runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from the org.hl7.fhir:kindling dependency, and keeps the old Argonaut IG entry commented out in source/igs.xml. Community search found no Confluence reference or conflicting core-source decision; the relevant Zulip hit concerns later Argonaut package dependency handling.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The issue describes retired tooling behavior that was already corrected historically and then moved out of this core source checkout, so editing current core specification source would not improve the current build.
